summary.text: John Marty is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 40 since January 2023, and previously District 66 beginning in 1987, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: John Marty lives in Roseville, Minnesota, and earned a bachelor's degree in ethics and society from St. Olaf College in 1978.

Ballotpedia lists his professional experience as including work as an administrator and researcher for the Minnesota House criminal justice committee from 1983 to 1984 and as communications director's aide for the Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party from 1979 to 1980.
He and his wife, Connie Jaarsma, have two children.
Marty represented Minnesota Senate District 66 from 1987 to 2023 and has represented District 40 since January 3, 2023.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he chairs the Senate Finance Committee and has authored legislation on government ethics and campaign finance, and that he has worked for universal health care.
He said he rejects special interest campaign contributions, and listed a fair economy, affordable housing and responding to climate change among his campaign messages.
